newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen staying unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen staying unchanged.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain unchanged with the chance of slight weakness, Westfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly report.
The eastern market indicator last week rose by 11 cents to 564 cents a kg clean, while the western market indicator rose eight cents to 525 cents a kg clean.
Sales this week are in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with a total of 99,853 bales on offer.
"Prices this week are expected to remain unchanged with the chance of slight weakness as the market works through these larger quantities on offer," Wesfarmers said.

Wesfarmers said there was a squeeze on the market as many buyers recognised prices were attractive enough to profitably cover previously sold positions and were under pressure to meet shipment dates before the end of the month.
"It is questionable whether this upturn can be sustained in the immediate term as there seem to be limited new orders available and the upcoming offering is generally less stylish."
"However, grower resistance is likely to prevent prices falling too far beyond current levels," it said.
